info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Fitness Memberships Classes-v1-spec
info.description: The Fitness Memberships Classes API provides a comprehensive listing of available fitness classes under various membership plans. This resource enables gyms, fitness studios, and wellness centers to showcase their class offerings, allowing users to browse options and determine suitable memberships. Typical consumers include gym managers looking to present classes attractively and members who wish to plan their fitness schedules. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their service visibility and improve member engagement through easy class discovery.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of available membership classes.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch a comprehensive list of all available membership classes, providing details such as class names, descriptions, and any associated benefits. Use this to explore your options and find the perfect class to suit your needs.

200.description: Successfully retrieved a list of membership classes.
